Commentary of al-Baghawi (Ma'alim al-Tanzil) on surah 82, verse 7–8:

﴿Who created you, then proportioned you, then made you balanced.﴾ The people of Kufa and Abu Ja'far read "fa'adalaka" with the light (takhfif) form, meaning He turned you and inclined you into whatever form He willed: good-looking and ugly, tall and short. The others read it with the doubled (tashdid) form, meaning He straightened you and made you of balanced creation and limbs.

﴿In whatever form He willed, He assembled you.﴾ Mujahid, al-Kalbi and Muqatil said: in whatever likeness of a father, a mother, a maternal uncle or a paternal uncle.

It has been related in a hadith: when the drop (nutfah) settles in the womb, every vein (irq) is brought forward between it and Adam, then he (the Prophet ﷺ) recited, "In whatever form He willed, He assembled you." [[Related by al-Tabari: 30/87.]]

al-Farra' mentioned another opinion: "In whatever form He willed, He assembled you" means that if He willed, it is in the form of a human being, and if He willed, it is in the form of an animal or another living creature.

His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿Indeed the righteous are in bliss﴾. The righteous (al-abrar) are those who were dutiful and truthful in their faith, by performing the obligations of Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He, and avoiding His disobedience.

﴿And indeed the wicked are in the Hellfire﴾. It is narrated that Sulayman ibn 'Abd al-Malik said to Abu Hazim al-Madani: "I wish I knew what our状况 is with Allah." He said: "In His saying: 'Indeed the righteous are in bliss, and indeed the wicked are in the Hellfire.'" Sulayman said: "Then where is the mercy of Allah?" He said: "'Indeed, the mercy of Allah is near to the good-doers'" [al-A'raf: 56].

His saying, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿They will burn therein on the Day of Recompense, and they will not be absent from it﴾: they will enter it on the Day of Resurrection.
